content: P0120 - Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Malfunction. The TPS or APP sensor circuit has an intermittent fault. Causes include damaged wiring, poor connector contact, or a failing sensor. Inspect wiring and sensor voltage.

P0121 - Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Range/Performance Problem. The TPS or APP sensor voltage is outside the expected correlation. Causes include a misadjusted sensor, contaminated potentiometer track, or failing sensor. Inspect and replace if readings are erratic.

P0122 - Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Low Input. The TPS or APP sensor voltage is below the minimum limit. Causes include a shorted signal wire or a failed sensor. Inspect wiring and connector.

P0123 - Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit High Input. The TPS or APP sensor voltage is above the maximum limit. Causes include an open signal wire or a failed sensor. Inspect wiring and sensor ground.

P0125 - Insufficient Coolant Temperature for Closed Loop Fuel Control. The ECT sensor does not reach the temperature required for closed-loop operation within the expected time. Causes include a failing thermostat, low coolant, or a failed ECT sensor. Inspect cooling system and sensor.
